## History

Anderson experiences the global emergence of a mysterious and massive sea creature that captures public attention and sparks intense scientific debate. As the creature begins causing dangerous collisions with vessels such as the [Moravian](../codex/tech.md#moravian) and the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia), Anderson witnesses the situation escalate into a public crisis. Consequently, Anderson observes the mounting pressure for the creature's removal following the significant damage inflicted upon international shipping.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017)_
